svg.title: One account: compare duties and freedom
svg.desc: Teaching summary of Plasencia's 1589 account of Tagalog communities: maharlika were free people with service duties; aliping namamahay could have their own homes and property while owing service; aliping sa gigilid served within another household under greater restrictions, including being saleable in the account. This is not a universal Philippine social pyramid.

g.text: One account: compare duties and freedom
Tagalog source example, 1589: not every region or historical period.
Compare conditions and sources. Social position does not measure human worth.
